claim: kgateway's GIE support is fully Kubernetes-CRD-driven (controllers reconcile InferencePool, auto-enabled only when the CRDs exist in-cluster) with no standalone or non-k8s mode scoped.
stance_target: which gateways only work with Kubernetes InferencePool
scope_conditions: kgateway (formerly k8sgateway/Gloo Edge) GIE meta-issue, Dec 2024 - Sep 2025
quoted_support: Add controllers that reconcile gateway-api-inference-extension custom resources, e.g. InferencePool. The controller should be optional, i.e. only run if the configuration option is enabled and the gateway-api-inference-extension CRDs exist.

claim: kgateway abandoned a plan to implement an Envoy 'Override Host' load-balancer policy (referencing Envoy PR #38757 and GIE PR #761) for honoring EPP-selected destinations, because kgateway's Envoy-based data plane is being deprecated in v2.1.
stance_target: using kgateway's Envoy override-host approach as a template for honoring EPP destinations
scope_conditions: kgateway roadmap as of issue closure, Sep 2025
quoted_support: Implement Override Host LB policy (Envoy PR and Infer Ext PR). No longer being pursued since the Envoy-based data plane is being deprecated in v2.1.

claim: kgateway treated failureMode (fail-open/fail-closed) support as a distinct follow-up feature rather than baseline functionality of its initial GIE integration.
stance_target: fail-open behavior is not a settled default across GIE gateway implementations
quoted_support: Add failureMode support as a follow-up to Add Initial Gateway API Inference Extension Support #10411.
